import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']

# Filter strictly to S6 doy 91-335 (April-November decision window)
s6 = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 6) & 
           (trips['fish_date_doy'] >= 91) & 
           (trips['fish_date_doy'] <= 335)].copy()

# Aggregate by doy and class
summary = s6.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'landing': 'count'
}).reset_index()
summary['rate'] = summary['yt'] / summary['anglers']

# Show class averages by 20-day window
print("=== S6 Class Performance by Window (doy 91-335) ===\n")
windows = {
    'April-May (91-130)': (91, 130),
    'May-June (131-170)': (131, 170),
    'July-Aug (171-210)': (171, 210),
    'Sept (211-240)': (211, 240),
    'Oct (241-305)': (241, 305),
    'Nov (306-335)': (306, 335)
}

for label, (start, end) in windows.items():
    window_data = summary[(summary['fish_date_doy'] >= start) & (summary['fish_date_doy'] <= end)]
    if len(window_data) == 0:
        continue
    
    print(f"\n{label}:")
    class_stats = window_data.groupby('cls').agg({
        'rate': 'mean',
        'yt': 'sum',
        'anglers': 'sum',
        'landing': 'count'
    }).sort_values('rate', ascending=False)
    
    for cls, row in class_stats.iterrows():
        print(f"  {cls:15s}: {row['rate']:6.2f} yt/angler ({int(row['yt'])} yt / {int(row['anglers'])} anglers, {int(row['landing'])} trips)")

# Now identify the ACTUAL peaks (multi-day averages)
print("\n=== Peak Days (single day high performers) ===")
peak_days = summary[summary['rate'] >= 3.0].sort_values('fish_date_doy')
print(peak_days[['fish_date_doy', 'cls', 'rate', 'yt', 'anglers']].head(20).to_string(index=False))

result = summary

# Generate summary stats for a forum post
trips = tables['trips']

s6 = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 6) & 
           (trips['fish_date_doy'] >= 91) & 
           (trips['fish_date_doy'] <= 335)].copy()

# Class performance by phase
phases = {
    'Phase 1 (Apr-May, d91-130)': (91, 130),
    'Phase 2 (May-Jun, d131-170)': (131, 170),
    'Phase 3 (Jul-Aug, d171-210)': (171, 210),
    'Phase 4 (Oct-Nov, d241-305)': (241, 305),
}

print("=== S6 Multi-Peak Analysis for Forum Post ===\n")
for phase_name, (start, end) in phases.items():
    phase_data = s6[(s6['fish_date_doy'] >= start) & (s6['fish_date_doy'] <= end)]
    
    # Best class in this phase
    class_performance = phase_data.groupby('cls').agg({
        'yt': 'sum',
        'anglers': 'sum'
    })
    class_performance['rate'] = class_performance['yt'] / class_performance['anglers']
    class_performance = class_performance.sort_values('rate', ascending=False)
    
    if len(class_performance) > 0:
        best_class = class_performance.index[0]
        best_rate = class_performance.iloc[0]['rate']
        print(f"{phase_name}")
        print(f"  Best class: {best_class} ({best_rate:.2f} yt/angler)")
        print(f"  Top 3 days: ", end="")
        
        # Find top 3 days in this phase
        phase_days = phase_data[phase_data['cls'] == best_class].groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
            'yt': 'sum',
            'anglers': 'sum'
        })
        phase_days['rate'] = phase_days['yt'] / phase_days['anglers']
        top_days = phase_days.nlargest(3, 'rate')
        print(", ".join([f"d{int(idx)}: {row['rate']:.2f}" for idx, row in top_days.iterrows()]))
        print()
